description: Garment silhouette is stretched, melted, bent, or structurally broken.
visual_symptom: Body/garment edge deviates from intended geometry.
root_cause: Generation drift, uncontrolled warp, bad mesh read, excessive distortion overlap.

description: Protected central product zone contains glitch, warp, or distortion.
visual_symptom: Any visible effect inside face/garment/weapon/logo protected zone.
root_cause: No exclusion mask, distortion spill, bad compositing.

description: Primary product edge loses crispness or receives effect bleed.
visual_symptom: Soft outline, halo, bloom bleed, edge contamination.
root_cause: Aggressive denoise/upscale, glow spill, compositing blur.

description: Fabric grain, stitching, or surface micro-detail is lost.
visual_symptom: Smoothed garment surface, haloing, dead material read.
root_cause: Denoise, upscale artifacts, blur, bad relighting.

description: Protected Z-Blue deviates from master swatch or gets contaminated.
visual_symptom: Hue drift, cast contamination, bloom spill, region shift.
root_cause: Grading, spill light, reflection contamination, effect overlap.

description: Distortion or background becomes stronger than subject/product.
visual_symptom: Viewer attention goes to effect/background first.
root_cause: Bad saliency balance, excessive contrast in wrong zone.

description: RGB split, VHS, or random noise appears in frame.
visual_symptom: Generic glitch language replaces controlled distortion.
root_cause: Preset effects, uncontrolled post-processing, weak prompt logic.

description: Distortion no longer follows geometry/grid logic.
visual_symptom: Effects float freely instead of snapping to architecture.

description: Protected zone loses recoverable detail through clipping.
visual_symptom: Blown highlights or crushed shadows on garment/product zone.
root_cause: Lighting imbalance, grading excess, bloom contamination.

description: Mask reveals human facial cues or loses symmetry.
visual_symptom: Visible eyes, facial mesh, asymmetry, emotive face read.
root_cause: Model drift, prompt weakness, stylization contamination.

description: Blade curves or gains fantasy ornamentation.
visual_symptom: Katana curve, medieval ornament, decorative fantasy language.

description: Porcelain shell reads as glossy plastic or toy surface.
visual_symptom: Candy gloss, PVC reflection, cheap synthetic read.
root_cause: Material drift, over-gloss lighting, poor texture definition.

visual_symptom: Toon eyes, rounded cheeks, playful body cues, soft stylization.
root_cause: Model stylization drift, weak negative locks.

description: Scene is polluted by generic cyber-neon clutter.
visual_symptom: Dense neon colors, flare spam, HUD layers, visual chaos.
